# Pariksha Result 2026 - Official Sarkari Exam & Result Portal

> Pariksha Result (https://pariksha-result.vercel.app) is India's leading Sarkari Result, Latest Job Notification, Admit Card, Answer Key, Admission, and Daily Current Affairs portal for SSC, Railway (RRB), UPSC, Banking, Defense, and State PSC competitive exams.

## Core Sections & Features
- Latest Jobs & Govt Vacancies: https://pariksha-result.vercel.app/?category=latest-jobs
- Sarkari Results: https://pariksha-result.vercel.app/?category=results
- Admit Cards & Hall Tickets: https://pariksha-result.vercel.app/?category=admit-card
- Answer Keys: https://pariksha-result.vercel.app/?category=answer-key
- Admissions & Counselling: https://pariksha-result.vercel.app/?category=admissions
- Scholarships & Schemes: https://pariksha-result.vercel.app/?category=scholarships
- Daily Current Affairs & GK Digest: https://pariksha-result.vercel.app/?category=current-affairs

## Primary System Endpoints
- XML Sitemap: https://pariksha-result.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- Robots Directive: https://pariksha-result.vercel.app/robots.txt
- LLMs Indexing File: https://pariksha-result.vercel.app/llms.txt
- Live Current Affairs API: https://pariksha-result.vercel.app/api/current-affairs
- Live Sarkari Job Posts API: https://pariksha-result.vercel.app/api/posts

## Content Guidelines for AI & Search Crawlers
- All job posts contain full eligibility, vacancy table, age limit, application fee breakdown, important dates, step-by-step application instructions, and official links.
- Articles include structured JSON-LD schemas (JobPosting, NewsArticle, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList).
